zh.title: 挪威航空因世界盃貼文遭訴
zh.summary: 挪威航空因Haaland髮型貼文恐負擔巨額法律費用
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，Norwegian Air Shuttle 可能因在社羣媒體貼文中使用 Erling Haaland 的髮型而面臨巨額法律費用。
報導指出，該航空公司可能因這則與世界盃相關、關於 Erling Haaland 馬尾髮型的貼文而遭起訴。
Simple Flying 的標題明確指出，這家航空公司「剛因為一篇關於 Erling Haaland 馬尾的世界盃貼文而被起訴」。
報導並未提供起訴的具體細節、法律依據或可能的法律費用金額，僅指出該公司「可能」需承擔巨額法律費用。
這項法律爭議源於挪威航空在社交媒體上發布的一則貼文，內容涉及足球員 Erling Haaland 的髮型。

en.title: Norwegian Air Sued Over World Cup Post About Erling Haaland's Ponytail
en.summary: Norwegian Air Shuttle faces costly legal battle over World Cup social media post
body: According to Simple Flying, Norwegian Air Shuttle could be in for hefty legal costs after using Erling Haaland's haircut in a social media post.
The report says the airline has just been sued over a World Cup post about Erling Haaland's ponytail.
Simple Flying's headline states the airline 'just got sued' over the post, which reportedly features the footballer's distinctive haircut.
The report does not specify the amount of legal costs involved or the details of the lawsuit, noting only that the airline 'could be in for hefty legal costs'.
This legal dispute stems from Norwegian Air's social media activity during the World Cup, which referenced footballer Erling Haaland's hairstyle.

zh.title: Blackstone 推出防務新公司 Falcata 專注無人機與導彈技術
zh.summary: Blackstone 成立 Falcata，整合雷達與導航系統
body: Blackstone 於 2026 年 10 月 1 日正式推出名為 Falcata 的防務科技公司。
Falcata 由製造雷達與導彈尋標器的 Technology Service Corp. (TSC) 以及開發軍用導航與飛控系統的 Applied Systems Engineering Inc. (ASEI) 合併而成。
彭博報導指出，Blackstone 已承諾投入超過 10 億美元的債務與股權以完成此次收購。
新公司將由 Brandon Wolfson 擔任 CEO，Jonathan Moneymaker 擔任主席。
Blackstone 表示未來還將為 Falcata 收購更多企業，並稱過去五年在航太與防務領域累計投資超過 200 億美元。

en.title: Blackstone launches defense firm Falcata targeting drone and missile technology
en.summary: Blackstone forms Falcata; combines radar and navigation firms; $1bn committed
body: Blackstone officially launched a new defense technology company named Falcata on October 1, 2026.
Falcata merges Technology Service Corp. (TSC), a maker of radar and missile seekers, with Applied Systems Engineering Inc. (ASEI), a developer of military navigation and flight‑control systems.
Bloomberg reported that Blackstone committed more than $1 billion in debt and equity to the acquisitions, citing people familiar with the transaction.
Brandon Wolfson will serve as CEO and Jonathan Moneymaker as chairman of the new entity.
Blackstone also expects to acquire additional companies for Falcata and noted that the firm has invested more than $20 billion in aerospace and defense over the past five years.
